metadata.question: Is Lake Langano more brown than Lake Abijata in March 29, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Two lakes in Ethiopia (Langano and Abijata). - Date: March 29, 2022 (specific date, allow ±5 days for cloud-free imagery). - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good spatial resolution for lakes, frequent revisit). - Fall back to Landsat 8/9 if needed. 2. **Masking strategy**: - Mask clouds using cloud probability or QA band. - Calculate "brownness" using spectral indices: Brown Index or simple ratio of red to blue (higher = more brown/sediment). - Could use a red/blue ratio or NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) adapted for sediment. - Alternatively: mean spectral values in red band (B4 for Sentinel-2). 3. **Logic**: - Extract geometries for both lakes (approximate coordinates). - Get Sentinel-2 images around March 29, 2022. - If no data, try Landsat. - Calculate brownness metric for each lake. - Compare: Is Langano's brown value > Abijata's? - If either lake has 0 valid pixels after masking → C2. - If calculation fails or invalid result → C3. - Otherwise → A (Yes) or B (No). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define lake geometries (Ethiopia, approximate coordinates) const langanoGeo = ee.Geometry.Point([38.75, 8.95]).buffer(5000); const abijataGeo = ee.Geometry.Point([39.50, 8.25]).buffer(5000); // 2. Date range around March 29, 2022 const startDate = '2022-03-24'; const endDate = '2022-04-03'; // 3. Sentinel-2 data with cloud mask let langanoCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(langanoGeo) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); let abijataCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(abijataGeo) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const langanoSize = await langanoCol.size().getInfo(); const abijataSize = await abijataCol.size().getInfo(); // 4. Check for data availability if (langanoSize === 0 || abijataSize === 0) { console.log(`Langano Images: ${langanoSize}, Abijata Images: ${abijataSize}`); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Prepare images (median composite) const langanoImg = langanoCol.median(); const abijataImg = abijataCol.median(); // 6. Calculate brownness using red band (B4) as proxy // Higher red band value = more sediment/brown const langanoRed = langanoImg.select('B4'); const abijataRed = abijataImg.select('B4'); // 7. Calculate mean red value (brownness metric) const langanoStats = await langanoRed.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: langanoGeo, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const abijataStats = await abijataRed.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: abijataGeo, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const langanoMean = langanoStats['B4_mean']; const abijataMean = abijataStats['B4_mean']; const langanoCount = langanoStats['B4_count']; const abijataCount = abijataStats['B4_count']; // 8. Validate pixel counts if (langanoCount === 0 || abijataCount === 0) { console.log(`Langano Valid Pixels: ${langanoCount}, Abijata Valid Pixels: ${abijataCount}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Validate results if (langanoMean === null || abijataMean === null || isNaN(langanoMean) || isNaN(abijataMean)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Compare brownness console.log(`Langano Images: ${langanoSize}, Red Mean: ${langanoMean.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${langanoCount}`); console.log(`Abijata Images: ${abijataSize}, Red Mean: ${abijataMean.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${abijataCount}`); console.log(`Langano Red > Abijata Red: ${langanoMean > abijataMean}`); if (langanoMean > abijataMean) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
